idea: Fruits: Ava draws a giant apple, Jimmy draws a dancing banana, the fruits roll away and the babies draw a basket to catch them.
title: Baby Jimmy's Magic Crayon! 🖍️ A GIANT Apple! 🍎 #shorts

idea: Music clip in the backyard: Sunny the lion cub tries to roar but only says meow; Jimmy, Ava and Biscuit cheer him on until he finds his big brave ROAR. Lesson: never give up.
title: Baby Lion Can't Roar! 🦁 Never Give Up | Crayon Babies

idea: NEW SIGNATURE SERIES 'What's Missing?' #1 (PLAYROOM): the babies' crayon drawing of a kitty comes to life as a real kid's crayon drawing (wobbly outlines, scribbly fill) - but it has NO TAIL. Ava asks the viewer 'What's missing?' (pause so kids can shout the answer), Jimmy draws the tail, the kitty hops and swishes it happily. Lesson: look carefully and fix it together; body parts (tail).
title: Oh No! Kitty Has No Tail! 🐱 What's Missing? | Crayon Babies
